key_insight: The paper introduces a multi-layer fusing transformer that combines image and text features with cross-attention to improve Vietnamese visual question answering.
clinical_relevance: While not a clinical study, Vietnamese VQA could support healthcare workflows such as patient education, triage support, and medical image-related communication in Vietnamese.
method: Uses a multi-layer fusing transformer to merge visual and textual representations.
Applies cross-attention to integrate features from different network layers.
Aggregates low-level to high-level information for richer multimodal understanding.
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on the ViVQA dataset and reported promising results against competitive baselines, supported by experiments and ablation studies.
watch_item: Performance is shown on a Vietnamese VQA benchmark, so real-world medical use would still require domain-specific validation and careful testing for reliability.
paper_title: Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
